name: DeepPCB
description: A printed-circuit-board defect dataset containing 1,500 aligned pairs of defect-free template and tested images annotated for six common PCB defect types.
citation: Tang, S., He, F., Huang, X., & Yang, J. (2019). Online PCB Defect Detector On A New PCB Defect Dataset. arXiv:1902.06197. https://arxiv.org/abs/1902.06197

license.notes: Dataset license not verified. The upstream README says the dataset is for research purposes only.
